name: indahl-number-check
description: Check every number in a report, memo, deck, dashboard or another skill's output against its source: each figure traced, then marked HELD, MOVED, NO_SOURCE or CANNOT_TELL with the source line beside it. Use after any research, finance, analytics or business-report skill, or before sending anything with numbers in it. Nothing is sent outside your session.
